mapper.sql: id, post_no, publisher_id, post_type, title, content, price, city_name, area_name, address, longitude, latitude, contact_name, contact_phone, status, reviewer_id, review_time, review_remark, publish_time, off_shelf_time, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tc.category_name ORDER BY tpc.sort_no ASC SEPARATOR ',') FROM trade_post_category tpc LEFT JOIN trade_category tc ON tc.id = tpc.category_id WHERE tpc.post_id = trade_post.id ) AS category_names_text, deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trade_post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM trade_post WHERE ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{query.userCityName} IS NOT NULL AND city_name = #{query.userCityName} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE WHEN #{query.userAreaName} IS NOT NULL AND area_name = #{query.userAreaName} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE WHEN #{query.userLongitude} IS NOT NULL AND #{query.userLatitude} IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude IS NOT NULL THEN POW(longitude - #{query.userLongitude}, 2) + POW(latitude - #{query.userLatitude}, 2) ELSE 99999999 END ASC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM trade_post WHERE deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_post (post_no, publisher_id, post_type, title, content, price, city_name, area_name, address, longitude, latitude, contact_name, contact_phone, status, reviewer_id, review_time, review_remark, publish_time, off_shelf_time, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{postNo}, #{publisherId}, #{postType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{price}, #{cityName}, #{areaName}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewTime}, #{reviewRemark}, #{publishTime}, #{offShelfTime}, #{deleted}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_post SET post_no = #{postNo}, publisher_id = #{publisherId}, post_type = #{postType}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, price = #{price}, city_name = #{cityName}, area_name = #{areaName}, address = #{address}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, off_shelf_time = #{offShelfTime}, deleted = #{deleted}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE trade_post SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT tc.category_name FROM trade_post tp INNER JOIN trade_post_category tpc ON tpc.post_id = tp.id INNER JOIN trade_category tc ON tc.id = tpc.category_id WHERE tp.deleted = 0 AND tp.status = 3 AND tc.status = 1 ORDER BY tc.category_name ASC
